title: an AI reads every reported item first, and a person makes the call

criteria.text: Every report and every poster rebuttal triggers one AI assessment, after the report is stored and hidden
criteria.note: `assessAfterReport` via `after()` from `create.ts`; the rebuttal triggers a read from `report-actions.ts`; a failed call leaves the report as is (#495, #513) [V] Checked: `[guards F100.1]` in `moderation/criteria.test.ts` [V] Reviewed: #756 `review-skipped` [V]

criteria.text: First pass is Claude Haiku, text and vision, structured output
criteria.note: `assess.ts`: Haiku, forced tool, zod, reason cut to 140; category, severity 1-4, confidence, outcome [V] Checked: `[guards F100.2]` in `moderation/criteria.test.ts` [V] Reviewed: #540, #756 `review-skipped` [V]

criteria.text: Below 0.70 confidence Sonnet gives a second opinion; both reads stored, the shown one is the second
criteria.note: `ESCALATION_THRESHOLD`; `run-assessment.ts` inserts each read [V] Checked: `[guards F100.3]` in `assess.test.ts` [V] Reviewed: #540 `review-skipped` [V]

criteria.text: Only the content, the reporter's reason and the rebuttal are sent; no name, handle or email; rules text versioned
criteria.note: Payload built in `assess.ts` from `AssessInput`; `RULES_VERSION` in the system prompt [V] Checked: `[guards F100.4]` in `assess.test.ts` and `guards.test.ts` [V] Reviewed: #540, #755, #756 `review-skipped` or no `Reviewed by:` [V]

criteria.text: Each assessment stores model, prompt version, category, severity, confidence, outcome, reason, latency, time; RLS on, no policies
criteria.note: `report_assessments` (migration 20261007260000) has every column; RLS on, no policy [V] Checked: `[guards F100.5]` in `tests/report-assessments-db.test.ts` [V] Reviewed: #495 says `Reviewed by: the builder` (counted literally) [A]

criteria.text: Shadow mode: an assessment changes nothing (save F102's severity-4 restore)
criteria.note: Only `report_assessments` is written in `runAssessment`; the restore step is the ruled exception [V] Checked: `[guards F100.6]` in `run-assessment.test.ts` [V] Reviewed: #540 `review-skipped` [V]

criteria.text: When a person decides, agreement is logged
Live mode is a data switch; live raises a row's severity and order; remove, restore, strikes stay a person's tap
criteria.note: `moderation_settings.ai_mode`, `fetchAiMode`; the higher of the two severities in live (#513) [V] Checked: `[guards F100.8]` in `moderation/criteria.test.ts` [V]

criteria.text: An evaluation harness prints recall, false alarms, severity accuracy, latency and cost; it runs on every prompt change
criteria.note: `npm run moderation:eval`; `moderation-eval.yml` runs on changes to the prompt, models, metrics and set; the full run needs the repo secret, else it is skipped with a note (last run green 2026-10-13) [V] Checked: partial markers only; #836 [V] Reviewed: #762, #767 no `Reviewed by:`; #522 `review-skipped` [V]

criteria.text: Builder agents build the labelled set: licensed photos, a children-rule case, an adult case, no minors in sensitive context
criteria.note: `evals/moderation/cases.json`: 55 cases (23 violating, 22 clean, 10 borderline), 10 with open-licence photos, two severity-1 and two child cases; `validateSet` refuses unlicensed, minor or sexual images (#767) [V] Checked: seven partial markers in `eval-cases.test.ts`; #836 [V] Reviewed: #767 no `Reviewed by:`; #522 `review-skipped` [V]

criteria.text: Beta half of 11: the PM sees recall, severity-1 recall, false alarms and shadow days against the targets
criteria.note: AI readiness panel on `/admin/reports` and the light on `/admin/metrics`, with green/amber/red per number (#754, ruled option C 2026-10-11) [V] Checked: partial markers only (`readiness.test.ts`, `eval-metrics.test.ts`); #836 [V] Reviewed: #754, #756 `review-skipped` [V] Smoked: `admin-reports` green 2026-10-14 [V]

criteria.text: Production half of 11: software refuses the live flip until a passing harness run and the shadow read are recorded
criteria.note: Not built, by ruling a production step (F100 `## Rulings` 2026-10-11, option C): `ai_mode` flips with no recorded run and nothing marks the shadow read [V]. Filed #837, not launch-blocking.

criteria.text: Suspected severity-1 content is never sent to an AI provider; images are hash-checked first (Cloudflare) and go to a person with the result
criteria.note: Built half: a `sensitive_content` report gets a skipped row, no model call and no image fetch (`run-assessment.ts`) [V], and photos can be served through the site for Cloudflare's scan, off until `NEXT_PUBLIC_MEDIA_VIA_SITE=1` (#784) [V]. Missing: the zone on Cloudflare and the CSAM Scanning Tool, the PM's setup (#641); rows say "Photo not scanned against known lists" [V] Checked: `[guards F100.12]` covers the skip half only.
